scope: Core editor experience upgrade without Monaco, CodeMirror, Tailwind, Shadcn, Vite, or dark mode.
modifiedAreas: HTML asset references and runtime version constants

editorChrome: renderEditorCard now wraps textarea controls in a lightweight editor frame.
Editor panels now include a line-number rail generated from current content, capped to avoid huge DOM output.
Editor panels now include a bottom status bar for editable/readonly state and char/line metrics.
YmirEditorPanel delegates to the same renderEditorCard helper so legacy component usage matches the new editor chrome.
visualSystem: Renamed the aesthetics stylesheet to ymir-developer-aesthetics-v53.css.
Removed faux textarea background gutters where v53 editor frame is active.
Added v53 CSS for editor frame, line gutter, status bar, mobile editor behavior, and action bar label polish.
syncScript: All generated HTML pages were resynced against the manifest/static registry.

notes: This is a lightweight editor-chrome pass, not a CodeMirror or Monaco integration.
Line numbers are intentionally capped at 240 to avoid heavy DOM output on large pasted content.
No npm build, tests, lint, or typecheck were run.
